scope: Read-only finite drawing hover distance with real world-space witnesses, projected/axis metrics and layer nearest supported object

fullNode.note: Before four additional geometry/lifecycle regressions and final evaluation-budget guard; covered by final focused run.

invariants: No document, selection, History or native geometry submission changes during hover.
Both witnesses belong to actual source geometry and carry object/element identities and parameters.
Metric, world mm, document/revision/epoch, error enclosure and accuracy are explicit.
Zoom changes screen projection only; edits, Undo, cancellation and document replacement invalidate stale results.
Unsupported layer targets are disclosed; nearest supported object is identified by name and ID.
limits: Finite point/line/polyline/rectangle, circle/arc/bulge, ellipse and positive rational spline geometry only.
World coordinates of stored geometry; no paper-scale/source-solid normalization.
Default tolerance 0.001 mm; unresolved budget results are approximate with a visible enclosure.
Floating-point geometric bounds with roundoff allowance, not arbitrary precision interval arithmetic.
512 pieces per object, 16384 initial pairs, 20000 evaluations per pair query, 80000 per layer; 32 eligible layer targets; 64 cached results.
Viewport-only state; no schema change or PDF reissue.
